YARIS HYBRID
IRRESISTIBLE STREET SYTLE
Stylish and dynamic, the new Yaris is an urban design icon. The small car with big
presence, it combines expressive proportions with a confident stance on the street.
Fun and full of character. There are attention-grabbing details everywhere you look,
from the streamlined roof line, the distinctive boomerang-shaped rear bumper to the
modern interior with the convenience features to help you do more. Don’t expect to
go unnoticed. 
Exciting and engaging to drive, the new Yaris Hybrid responds instantly with the
energetic acceleration to leave the rest behind. 
Scan the QR code to learn more about the Yaris Hybrid!

DISCOVER HYBRID
Why Hybrid? 
Refuel as usual
Refuelling a Hybrid car is easy. Top up your Toyota Hybrid with petrol at a
filling station, as you would a conventional car.
Responsive and efficient 
Toyota Hybrids seamlessly combine petrol and electric power to optimise
efficiency and deliver smooth, responsive power. They drive much like a
conventional car but can cover up to 42% of your driving distance and 56%
of your driving time in electric-only EV modes.
No Plugging In
Toyota Hybrids charge their batteries while braking and coasting. Together
with their onboard combustion engine, this means you don’t need to worry
about electric range, and no need to plug in your car to charge.
Scan the QR Code to learn more about Toyota Hybrid!
Toyota has pioneered Hybrid technology for more than 25 years. Our Hybrid cars are
enjoyed by millions of drivers on the road today. Toyota’s latest fifth-generation
Hybrids combine an electric motor and a petrol engine in one best-of-both-worlds
powertrain, delivering impressive performance and driving range.

ALWAYS ON THE GO,
ALWAYS CONNECTED
The intelligent cockpit keeps everything in sync between your vehicle and
smartphone. The MyToyota App, designed to enhance the driving experience, opens
up a world of connectivity. 
Depending on the model, the MyToyota App provides a suite of services that enable
real-time updates, viewing trip history, and access to coaching features aimed at
optimizing your driving performance, ensuring you get the most from your Toyota. 
Scan the QR code to learn more about the My Toyota App!

TOYOTA SAFETY SENSE
Toyota Safety Sense features a set of five active technologies with the ultimate
goal being to reduce traffic accidents as much as possible, helping to create a
safer driving environment for everyone, while supporting you in your daily
journey.
Scan the QR Code to learn more about Toyota Safety Sense!
Adaptive Cruise Control
Drivers can choose their cruising speed at a pre-set distance from the
vehicle in front. If this distance falls, the system will reduce it’s speed.
Automatic High Beam 
Designed to optimise visibility during night driving by automatically
switching between high and low beam for oncoming vehicles and
leading traffic
Lane Departure Alert
The lane-centring function will alert the driver if the vehicle starts to
deviate from it’s lane.
Pre-Collision System
Recognizes a potential head-on impact and a wide range of objects in
the car’s path, including pedestrians, cyclists and motorcycles.
Road Sign Assist
Monitors the road signs ahead, displaying useful information such as the
current speed limit.

MANUFACTURER’S
WARRANTY
For peace of mind Toyota manufacturer’s warranty ensures that every trip runs
smoothly with:
 
Manufacturer Warranty
• 3yrs/100,000km - Manufacturers Warranty
• 5yrs/100,000km - All Hybrid Components
• 12yrs/unlimited mileage – Corrosion Perforation
Roadside Assistance
3 years of roadside assistance with Toyota Eurocare in the case of: 
• Mechanical breakdown
• Accident
• No fuel
Flat battery
Flat Tyre
Key lost or locked in
Hybrid Warranty
• 5yrs/100,000km - All Hybrid Components (Including Hybrid Battery)
• Up to 15yrs/unlimited mileage Hybrid Battery Extended Care once
  serviced with a Toyota Dealer
Call Toyota Eurocare on 1800-741-700 or from abroad +353 1 6193640
For further warranty details or recovery services contact your local Toyota Dealer.

TOYOTA RELAX
Toyota Relax is a testament to the confidence we place in the quality of our vehicles. After your
manufacturer’s warranty finishes, you can still feel complete peace of mind, with a new 12
month or 15,000km Toyota Relax warranty if you service your vehicle with us. So you can rest
assured that your car is in safe hands with expert technicians, who only use genuine parts. So
your Toyota stays 100% Toyota.
 
If you choose to service with us, you are eligible for a new Toyota Relax warranty - up to 10 years
vehicle age or 185,000km (whichever comes first) after the expiration of the manufacturer’s
warranty. See Toyota Website (www.toyota.ie/relax) for more details.
